content.text:
Yes — **Meeting SDK itself is free to download and code with, no per-minute fee.**

But hosted meetings follow your **Zoom host account plan**, not the SDK:

**1. SDK = free**
> No charge to install `@zoom/meetingsdk`, get SDK Key/Secret, use Server-to-Server OAuth, join meetings in browser.

**2. Meetings = needs a Zoom plan**
> What the HR interviewer (host) owns decides limits:

* **Free Basic - ₱0:** you can already embed real meetings in your popup. Unlimited 1-on-1, group meetings **up to 40 mins** (3-100 people). For most interviews this is actually enough.
* **Pro (~$13-15 / mo / host):** removes 40-min limit, + cloud recording, + auto-transcripts.
* **No extra fee** per applicant or per join — only the 1 host account needs Pro.

That's different from **Video SDK** (your own custom video UI) — that one *is* pay-per-minute.

### For your case: `Start Zoom Interview` popup

What you have now:

```
[local camera preview (getUserMedia)] + [Open in Zoom links]
-> clicks out to zoom.us app / browser tab
```

With Meeting SDK Component View:

```
[same popup, same eval form]
+ real Zoom meeting embedded inside the Video Preview pane
-> no Zoom software, stays in HRMS, HR + applicant see/hear each other there
```

Requirements to do that:
1. Free Zoom Developer account -> Meeting SDK app (get SDK Key/Secret) + Server-to-Server OAuth (to create real meetings via API to replace your `ZoomMeetingService` mock)
2. `https` (localhost ok for dev)
3. I replace your mock `zoom.us/j/...` links with real `meetingNumber + token` and mount `client.join()` inside your `zoomVideoRef` box.

Want me to wire it so:

* If real Zoom creds exist -> shows **embedded Zoom** in the popup?
* If not -> falls back to your current **local preview + Open in Zoom** (zero cost)?

That way you can use it free now (40-min limit) and upgrade to Pro later only if interviews run long / you need cloud recording.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

/**
 * Zoom virtual-interview link generator.
 *
 * Two providers behind the same return shape (callers and emails unchanged):
 *
 *  - mock (default, no keys): deterministic Zoom-style meeting (meeting ID +
 *    join link + continue/rejoin link + password) stored on the interview row.
 *  - api  (ZOOM_PROVIDER=api + Server-to-Server OAuth creds): creates a REAL
 *    Zoom meeting via POST https://api.zoom.us/v2/users/me/meetings so the
 *    frontend Meeting SDK Component View can embed it in the HRMS popup
 *    (no Zoom app needed). Falls back to mock when creds/API fail.
 *
 * Env:
 *   ZOOM_PROVIDER=mock|api, ZOOM_SDK_KEY, ZOOM_SDK_SECRET,
 *   ZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID, ZOOM_CLIENT_ID, ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET
 */
class ZoomMeetingService
{
    /**
     * @return array{meeting_id:string,join_url:string,continue_url:string,password:string}
     */
    public static function createForInterview(
        string $interviewCode,
        string $applicantName,
        ?string $interviewerName = null,
        ?string $position = null,
    ): array {
        // Real-provider hook: try the Zoom API, fall back to mock on failure.
        if (config('services.zoom.provider') === 'api') {
            $real = static::createViaApi($interviewCode, $applicantName, $interviewerName, $position);
            if ($real !== null) {
                return $real;
            }
        }

        return static::createMock($interviewCode);
    }

    /** Mock Zoom-style meeting (no external calls). */
    protected static function createMock(string $interviewCode): array
    {
        // Mock Zoom-style meeting ID: 3-4-4 digit groups like real Zoom IDs.
        $digits = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i < 11; $i++) {
            $digits .= (string) random_int(0, 9);
        }
        // Ensure it starts non-zero like a real meeting ID.
        if ($digits[0] === '0') {
            $digits[0] = (string) random_int(1, 9);
        }
        $meetingId = substr($digits, 0, 3).' '.substr($digits, 3, 4).' '.substr($digits, 7, 4);
        $meetingIdCompact = str_replace(' ', '', $meetingId);

        // 6-char alphanumeric password (Zoom style).
        $alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789';
        $password = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i < 6; $i++) {
            $password .= $alphabet[random_int(0, strlen($alphabet) - 1)];
        }

        // Zoom join links carry an encrypted ?pwd= hash; emulate with url-safe base64.
        $pwdHash = rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($interviewCode.':'.$password), '+/', '-_'), '=');
        $joinUrl = "https://zoom.us/j/{$meetingIdCompact}?pwd={$pwdHash}";
        // 2nd link: same meeting, flagged as continue/rejoin (used if dropped).
        $continueUrl = "https://zoom.us/j/{$meetingIdCompact}?pwd={$pwdHash}&continue=1#rejoin";

        return [
            'meeting_id'   => $meetingIdCompact,
            'join_url'     => $joinUrl,
            'continue_url' => $continueUrl,
            'password'     => $password,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Create a REAL Zoom meeting via Server-to-Server OAuth.
     * Returns null when not configured / API fails (caller falls back to mock).
     *
     * @return array{meeting_id:string,join_url:string,continue_url:string,password:string}|null
     */
    protected static function createViaApi(
        string $interviewCode,
        string $applicantName,
        ?string $interviewerName = null,
        ?string $position = null,
    ): ?array {
        $accountId = (string) config('services.zoom.account_id');
        $clientId = (string) config('services.zoom.client_id');
        $clientSecret = (string) config('services.zoom.client_secret');
        if ($accountId === '' || $clientId === '' || $clientSecret === '') {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // 1) OAuth access token (account_credentials grant).
            $tokenRes = Http::asForm()->post('https://zoom.us/oauth/token', [
                'grant_type' => 'account_credentials',
                'account_id' => $accountId,
            ] + [], /* body */
            )->withBasicAuth($clientId, $clientSecret);
            // withBasicAuth must wrap the post — rebuild correctly:
            $tokenRes = Http::withBasicAuth($clientId, $clientSecret)->asForm()->post(
                'https://zoom.us/oauth/token',
                ['grant_type' => 'account_credentials', 'account_id' => $accountId]
            );
            if (! $tokenRes->successful()) {
                Log::warning('Zoom OAuth failed: '.$tokenRes->body());
                return null;
            }
            $accessToken = (string) ($tokenRes->json('access_token') ?? '');
            if ($accessToken === '') {
                return null;
            }

            // 2) Create the meeting (scheduled, waiting room + passcode on).
            $topic = trim("Interview — {$applicantName}".($position ? " ({$position})" : ''));
            $agenda = trim("{$interviewCode}".($interviewerName ? " · Interviewer: {$interviewerName}" : ''));
            $createRes = Http::withToken($accessToken)->post('https://api.zoom.us/v2/users/me/meetings', [
                'topic'      => mb_substr($topic, 0, 200),
                'type'       => 2, // scheduled meeting
                'agenda'     => mb_substr($agenda, 0, 2000),
                'settings'   => [
                    'waiting_room'      => true,
                    'join_before_host'  => false,
                    'approval_type'     => 2, // no registration required
                    'auto_recording'    => 'none',
                ],
            ]);
            if (! $createRes->successful()) {
                Log::warning('Zoom create meeting failed: '.$createRes->body());
                return null;
            }
            $meetingId = (string) ($createRes->json('id') ?? '');
            $joinUrl = (string) ($createRes->json('join_url') ?? '');
            $password = (string) ($createRes->json('password') ?? '');
            if ($meetingId === '' || $joinUrl === '') {
                return null;
            }

            return [
                'meeting_id'   => $meetingId,
                'join_url'     => $joinUrl,
                'continue_url' => $joinUrl.'#rejoin',
                'password'     => $password,
            ];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning('Zoom API error: '.$e->getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Whether the SDK embed is configured (real meetingNumber + SDK key pair). */
    public static function sdkConfigured(): bool
    {
        return (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_key') !== ''
            && (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_secret') !== '';
    }

    /**
     * Mint a Meeting SDK JWT signature for Component View join.
     * Returns null when SDK keys are missing. The secret never leaves the server.
     */
    public static function sdkSignature(string $meetingNumber, int $role = 0): ?string
    {
        $sdkKey = (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_key');
        $sdkSecret = (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_secret');
        if ($sdkKey === '' || $sdkSecret === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $header = ['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'JWT'];
        $payload = [
            'sdkKey'          => $sdkKey,
            'mn'              => preg_replace('/\D/', '', $meetingNumber),
            'role'            => $role, // 0 = attendee (HR joins as attendee), 1 = host
            'iat'             => time(),
            'exp'             => time() + 60 * 60 * 2, // 2h validity
            'appKey'          => $sdkKey,
            'tokenExp'        => time() + 60 * 60 * 2,
        ];

        $b64 = static fn (string $json): string => rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($json), '+/', '-_'), '=');
        $unsigned = $b64((string) json_encode($header)).'.'.$b64((string) json_encode($payload));
        $sig = hash_hmac('sha256', $unsigned, $sdkSecret, true);

        return $unsigned.'.'.rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($sig), '+/', '-_'), '=');
    }

    /**
     * Fill Zoom columns on an interview model when it is Virtual and has none.
     * Returns true when links were generated.
     */
    public static function ensureForModel(object $interview, ?string $position = null): bool
    {
        if (($interview->mode ?? null) !== 'Virtual') {
            return false;
        }
        if (! empty($interview->zoom_join_url)) {
            return false;
        }
        $applicantName = $interview->applicant?->name ?? 'Applicant';
        $zoom = static::createForInterview(
            (string) ($interview->interview_code ?? 'INT'),
            $applicantName,
            $interview->interviewer_name,
            $position ?? $interview->applicant?->jobPost?->title,
        );
        $interview->zoom_meeting_id = $zoom['meeting_id'];
        $interview->zoom_join_url = $zoom['join_url'];
        $interview->zoom_continue_url = $zoom['continue_url'];
        $interview->zoom_password = $zoom['password'];

        return true;
    }
}

Route is live. Here's your exact setup:

### Setup: live embedded Zoom (5 steps)

**1. Create a Meeting SDK app** (gives you the embed keys)
- Go to https://marketplace.zoom.us → Develop → Build App → **Meeting SDK** → Create
- Name it `HRMS Interviews`, get your **SDK Key** + **SDK Secret**
- Add your dev URL to Redirect/Allow lists: `http://localhost:5173`

**2. Create a Server-to-Server OAuth app** (lets the backend make real meetings)
- Same marketplace → Build App → **Server-to-Server OAuth** → Create
- Add scopes: `meeting:write`, `meeting:read`, `user:read`
- Get **Account ID** + **Client ID** + **Client Secret**

**3. Fill your backend `.env`** (in `backend-laravel/.env`):
```env
ZOOM_PROVIDER=api
ZOOM_SDK_KEY=paste_sdk_key
ZOOM_SDK_SECRET=paste_sdk_secret
ZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID=paste_account_id
ZOOM_CLIENT_ID=paste_client_id
ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET=paste_client_secret
```
Then: `php artisan config:clear`

**4. Book a Virtual interview** — from now on it creates a **real** Zoom meeting (real `zoom.us/j/<id>` link emailed to the applicant).

> Old mock interviews still have fake IDs — embedded join will fail on those. Just book a fresh Virtual interview (or reschedule an old one so links regenerate) after step 3.

**5. Click "Start Zoom Interview"**
- With keys → popup header flips to **"Zoom meeting — live in system"** with the applicant + you on video **inside the HRMS** (browser will ask camera/mic permission once).
- Without keys → same popup as before (local preview + Open in Zoom buttons). Nothing breaks.

**Quick test checklist:**
- [ ] `php artisan route:list --name=interview` shows `zoom-signature` ✅ (just confirmed above)
- [ ] Serve over `http://localhost:5173` (or https in prod — Zoom requires valid origin)
- [ ] Applicant opens their emailed link in the real Zoom app while you stay embedded — you'll see each other.

Cost reminder from earlier: SDK is free; meetings follow your host account (Free plan = 40-min group limit, Pro removes it).

content.text:
That exact text only appears in the 2nd `catch` — signature OK, but `init()`/`join()` threw. Top causes, in order:

**1. Fake/mock meeting ID (most likely for you)**
Your screenshot's interview was probably booked while `ZOOM_PROVIDER=mock` — those `zoom.us/j/...` links don't exist on Zoom, so the SDK rejects the join even with valid keys. Fix: book a **fresh Virtual interview now** (provider is `api` + keys present, so it'll be a real `us05web.zoom.us/j/<id>`), then Start Zoom on that one.

**2. SDK Key ↔ Meeting mismatch**
The signature's `sdkKey` must belong to the same Zoom account that owns the meeting. If `ZOOM_SDK_KEY` came from a different marketplace app/account than the S2S OAuth app that created the meeting → join fails. Fix: both apps under the **same** marketplace account.

**3. Meeting SDK app not activated / origin not allowed**
- Marketplace → your Meeting SDK app → **Activate**.
- Add `http://localhost:5173` (and your prod URL) to the SDK app's allow list.
- Production needs **https** — Zoom blocks `http` origins except localhost.

**4. Browser blocked it**
Needs camera/mic permission + a Chromium browser (Chrome/Edge). Ad-blockers/strict privacy sometimes kill the SDK WASM.

**I just pushed a fix** so the box will now show the real cause, e.g.:
> `Embedded Zoom could not start in this browser (Invalid meeting number / signature expired / ...) — use the Join link below.`

**To confirm:** refresh, reopen Start Zoom Interview, and tell me the new text in parentheses + press F12 → Console → copy the `Zoom embedded join failed:` line. That tells us exactly which of the 4 it is. Also tell me: was that Maricel interview booked **before** you added the Zoom keys?
